narrative_purpose: Close the chapter's two halves on each other: a burn where the ash bed landed on living soil and the green is already back, beside a burial where the same fertility was sealed under sterile tephra and nothing returned.
subject: LEFT HALF: a burnt forest floor where charred blackened stumps stand in a thin layer of pale grey ash, and a dozen bright teal-green shoots and small ferns push up vigorously through that ash, with dark brown soil visible where the ash is thin. RIGHT HALF: a flat featureless plain of deep coarse grey tephra with the tall calcined skeleton of one giant tree standing in it, bark gone, wood cooked pale, and not one green thing anywhere.
scene: A single continuous landscape running left to right, the two halves meeting at a soft transition near the middle, under one dim ashen indigo sky with layered haze.
camera: Wide level landscape view, low horizon, both halves at the same scale and lit by the same sky.
light: One uniform dim overcast light across the whole frame so nothing is dramatised; the young shoots on the left carry a faint living teal luminosity, the right half is entirely cool grey and unlit.
palette: Cool grey and indigo dominant across both halves, with living teal-green confined strictly to the left half and no warm accents anywhere.
style: Painterly naturalist landscape plate, bleak and even-handed, presenting two cases for comparison.
detail_level: High on the green shoots and charred stumps at left and on the calcined tree at right; both distances dissolving into flat grey haze.
composition: A single wide panorama with no drawn divider, the left third dense with regrowth, the right two thirds emptying into featureless grey, a broad band of plain dim sky across the top kept clear for overlaid callouts.
exclude: green vegetation on the right half
consistency_notes: The contrast is regrowth versus nothing. Green appears ONLY in the left half; the right half must be completely bare grey. No divider or panel border between them — one continuous landscape. No active fire or smoke anywhere; both burns are long over. Matches the grey tephra and calcined megaflora of the Ashlands.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no dividing line or panel border, no arrows, no active flames or smoke, no green plants on the right side, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
